source.factions: Factions of Doskvol, official Campaign Tracking sheet v8.2 (bladesinthedark.com downloads). Names, tiers and W/S hold marks were transcribed from it.
source.districts: All twelve Citizenry rows on the official Factions of Doskvol sheet v8.2 are districts, including Whitecrown. District summaries are original app-written descriptions informed by the core-book gazetteer.
source.locations: Canonical names checked against the core-book district gazetteer (printed pages 256-279) and official Player's Kit v8.2 vice-purveyor list and city map. Location descriptions are original app-written text; sources identify the publication, not a licence grant.
source.licence: Setting material of Blades in the Dark (Duskwall/Shattered Isles), the property of John Harper / One Seven Design. Included for a free fan project; not CC-BY. The SRD licence at https://bladesinthedark.com/licensing excludes this setting material.

holds.strong: Strong (sheet mark S; faction-game SRD: S = strong)
holds.weak: Weak (sheet mark W; faction-game SRD: W = weak)

districts.name: Whitecrown
districts.summary: Imperial estates and elite institutions stand behind guarded approaches, separating the city's powerful residents from ordinary street life.

locations.name: Doskvol Academy
locations.description: An elite academy where the city's privileged students receive their education.

locations.name: Dusk Manor Club
locations.description: Lady Dusk's club offers gambling among Whitecrown's other exclusive diversions.

locations.name: Spiregarden Theater
locations.description: Maestro Helleren's theater brings performances and artistic patrons to Whitecrown.

districts.name: Brightstone
districts.summary: Grand townhouses and exclusive shops shelter the city's wealthiest families, with private security keeping poverty outside their polished streets.

locations.name: Centuralia Club
locations.description: A private club where affluent patrons gather for conversation and companionship.

locations.name: Silver Swan
locations.description: A pleasure barge offering wealthy guests an escape from the streets.

districts.name: Charterhall
districts.summary: Courts, civic offices, banks, and a university crowd this administrative center, where official connections can matter as much as money.

locations.name: Charterhall University
locations.description: Converted buildings house students and classrooms beneath the imposing Sparkwright Tower.

locations.name: Charter Wall
locations.description: Artist colonies occupy the remains of the city's ancient defensive wall.

districts.name: Six Towers
districts.summary: Decaying mansions mark a once-fashionable quarter, now shared by stubborn old residents, squatters, and dangers hidden in abandoned properties.

locations.name: House of the Weeping Lady
locations.description: A religious refuge where devotees seek comfort in the service of faith.

locations.name: Golden Plum
locations.description: Chef Roselle's restaurant offers fine food amid the district's faded grandeur.

districts.name: Silkshore
districts.summary: Artists, pleasure-seekers, and vice purveyors mingle in canal-side streets, where entertainment and illicit indulgence keep business moving.

locations.name: Red Lamp
locations.description: Madame Tesslyn's brothel caters to visitors seeking the district's carnal pleasures.

locations.name: Silver Stag
locations.description: Helene's casino welcomes gamblers looking to risk their coin on a fortunate evening.

districts.name: Nightmarket
districts.summary: New money and foreign commerce meet around the rail station, where traders can find rare goods and discreet deals.

locations.name: Harping Monkey
locations.description: Pux Bolin's tavern serves drinks and company in the busy trading district.

locations.name: The Veil
locations.description: Rolan Volaris's social club gives its patrons a place to mingle away from market business.

districts.name: Crow's Foot
districts.summary: Rival street gangs contest a dense district of tenements and canals, turning blocks and bridges into disputed territory.

locations.name: Crow's Nest
locations.description: An ancient tower serves as headquarters for the Crows and overlooks their contested territory.

locations.name: Red Sash Sword Academy
locations.description: An Iruvian sword school doubles as the Red Sashes' headquarters and a cover for criminal business.

locations.name: Leaky Bucket
locations.description: Mardin Gull's public house offers drinks under the eye of a retired gang leader.

districts.name: The Docks
districts.summary: Leviathan-hunter ships and ocean trade pack the waterfront, bringing sailors, cargo, and dangerous business into the same crowded streets.

locations.name: The North Hook Company
locations.description: A long-established shipping and naval-exploration company operates a large fleet of trading vessels.

locations.name: Catcrawl Alley
locations.description: Jewel, Bird, and Shine offer companionship among the waterfront's other diversions.

districts.name: Barrowcleft
districts.summary: Farmworkers and agricultural markets support the city's food supply, with radiant energy keeping crops alive beneath the eternal night.

locations.name: Barrow Bridge
locations.description: Homes, shops, and market stalls crowd the broad bridge connecting Barrowcleft with the city.

locations.name: Barrowcleft Market
locations.description: Farm produce draws buyers to a market known for fair dealing and community oversight.

districts.name: Coalridge
districts.summary: Smoke and furnace glare fill this industrial quarter, where crowded factories and hard-pressed workers keep the city's machinery running.

locations.name: Coalridge Mine
locations.description: The ancient mine still produces coal as the city increasingly turns to electroplasmic power.

locations.name: The Old Rail Yard
locations.description: A former freight hub now handles a few heavy cargo trains among abandoned rail cars.

locations.name: Traven's Smoke Shop
locations.description: Traven supplies intoxicating smoke to customers seeking relief from the industrial district.

districts.name: Charhollow
districts.summary: Workers and their families share crowded tenements and lively markets, where close neighborhood ties contrast with a shortage of money.

locations.name: Charhollow Market
locations.description: A public square hosts traders selling everyday goods at prices local residents can afford.

locations.name: Strangford House
locations.description: The powerful family's fenced hilltop estate overlooks the homes of many of its workers.

districts.name: Dunslough
districts.summary: Prison labor and grinding poverty shape this neglected district, home to people the rest of the city prefers to ignore.

locations.name: Ironhook Prison
locations.description: A looming metal fortress confines many of the city's most dangerous prisoners.

locations.name: Dunvil Labor Camp
locations.description: Prisoners break quarried rock and load ore onto barges under harsh compulsory labor.
